Another Hand-Grenade
Tossed At Chinese Stu-
dent Federation

ONE WOUNDED
ONLY CASUALTY

French Police Said To
Have Nabbed Head
Of One Gang

Shanghai's crop of terrorists re-
mained active yesterday and carried
out two more bombings. The places
bombed were:
The Sin Wan Pao, leading Chinese
daily newspaper, situated at the
corner of Hankow and Shantung
Roads. A home-made hand grenade
was thrown at the premises from
the outside of the building at 6.55
p.m.
The building occupied by the
China Critic, well-known and
popular Chinese English-language
weekly, and the World Chinese
Students' Federation, 191 Carter
Road. This bombing also occurred
at 6.55 p.m. One Chinese male who
was standing in front of the building
was wounded.
Police authorities are at a loss to
understand the motives back of both
bombings since the Sin Wan Pao
and the China Critic are both
strictly Chinese organizations with
no local political affiliations at the
present time.
The bomb tossed at the Sin Wan
Pao landed near the main entrance
of the building but caused very
little damage. Some of the wood-
work was marred but that was about
all.

One Injured
The missile hurled at the China
Critic building exploded near the
entrance, causing some damage
and wounding a Chinese male who
happened to be nearby at the time.
Both Settlement and French Con-
cession police officials yesterday
also continued active in their war
against the terrorist elements which
have crept across the boundaries of
the two foreign controlled areas.
Raids staged Friday night and
yesterday morning in the Settle-
ment resulted in the arrest of seven
men and one woman by detectives
of the Slnza Police Station, all of
whom are being interrogated for al-
leged terroristic activities.
Two pistols, one a Mauser and
the other a Demon, together with
30 rounds of ammunition were
found in their possession.

Leader Said Arrested
The French Police last night
believed that they had in their
custody the ringleader of one band
of terrorists, allegedly responsible
for several recent bomb plots.
The man's name is Kou Tien-fou
and he was arrested early yesterday
morning in a hideout off Route
Frelupt. Knowledge of his exist-
ence reached the ears of the
French Police through a terrorist
suspect arrested Friday night on
Rue Montauban.

in the possession of the latter
was a package which contained
several mauser cartridges. At first
the man denied that he was a
terrorist but claimed that the pack-
age had been given him to transport
from one address to another and
that he was not aware of its con-
tents.
At the police station the fellow
later confessed that the pistol had
been given to him by Kou, whom,
he said, apparently had charge of
the distribution of firearms to per-
sons engaged in terroristic enter-
prises in this city.
Kou's address on Route Frelupt
also was given and the police lost
little time in raiding the place.
They found Kou at home and
promptly took him into custody.
Two other persons, also on the
scene at the time, were also taken
into custody.
A search of the premises produced
another Mauser pistol as well as an
automatic of the Hersthal make.
Fifty-two rounds of ammunition
also were found on the premises.

Kou Admits Connection
When questioned at the police
station, Kou, according to the
French authorities, admitted that he
was an executive of a local terror-
istic association and that it was
his job to distribute ammunition to
members of the band.
Kou, it was stated, was quite
frank in his admission while the two
men who were arrested with him
openly admitted their connection
with the terrorist organization.
Upon information furnished by
them, a woman was arrested in a
small lodging house on Route Fre-
lupt. She also is alleged to have
been connected with the band. The
inquiry is being continued.

Added Precautions
Added precautions against bomb-
ing activities were taken in the
downtown areas yesterday by the
International Settlement police.
Besides the strengthening of police
patrols, heavy patrols of members
of the Russian Regiment were used.
The latter patrols, numbering five
men to each patrol, marched single-
file along every block in the Cen-
tral and Louza Districts.
They were armed with rifles which
were carried under their arms ready
for action at a moment's notice.
pages.zh:
《新闻报》
遭恐怖分子
炸弹袭击

另一枚手榴弹
被投向中国学生
联合会

仅一人受伤
为唯一伤亡者

据称法国警察
已逮捕一帮派头目

上海的恐怖分子活动昨日依然活跃，并又实施了两起爆炸案。被炸地点如下：
位于汉口路与山东路拐角处的《新闻报》，这是一家主要的中文日报。下午6时55分，有人从建筑物外部向该处投掷了一枚自制手榴弹。
位于卡特路191号的《中国评论周报》（China Critic）办公楼及世界中国学生联合会所在地，《中国评论周报》是一份知名且受欢迎的中文英文周刊。此次爆炸也发生在下午6时55分。一名站在楼前的中国男子受伤。
警方当局对这两起爆炸案背后的动机感到困惑，因为《新闻报》和《中国评论周报》均为纯粹的华人机构，目前没有任何本地政治背景。
投向《新闻报》的炸弹落在大楼主入口附近，但造成的破坏很小。部分木制品受损，但也仅此而已。

一人受伤
投向《中国评论周报》大楼的投掷物在入口附近爆炸，造成一定破坏，并炸伤了一名当时恰好在附近的中国男子。
昨日，公共租界和法租界的警务官员继续积极打击已渗透进这两个外国管制区域边界的恐怖分子势力。
周五晚间和昨日上午在租界内进行的突袭行动，导致新闸捕房的侦探逮捕了七名男子和一名女子，所有人均因涉嫌恐怖活动而正在接受审讯。
在他们身上搜出了两支手枪，一支为毛瑟枪（Mauser），另一支为德蒙牌（Demon），以及30发子弹。

据称首领被捕
法国警察昨晚相信，他们已拘留了一个恐怖团伙的头目，该人据称对近期几起炸弹阴谋负责。
此人名叫寇天福（Kou Tien-fou，音译），他于昨日清晨在弗里鲁普路（Route Frelupt，音译）附近的一处藏身之所被捕。法国警察是通过周五晚在蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）逮捕的一名恐怖嫌疑犯得知其存在的。

在该嫌疑犯身上有一个包裹，里面装有几发毛瑟子弹。起初，此人否认自己是恐怖分子，声称该包裹是让他从一个地址运送到另一个地址的，他并不知道里面的内容。
在警察局，此人后来供认，手枪是寇某给他的，他说寇某显然负责向本市从事恐怖活动的人员分发枪支。
寇某在弗里鲁普路的地址也被供出，警方随即迅速突袭了该处。他们在家里发现了寇某，并立即将其拘留。当时在场的另外两人也被拘留。
对该住所的搜查还缴获了另一支毛瑟手枪以及一支赫斯塔爾（Hersthal）制造的自动手枪。在该住所还发现了五十二发子弹。

寇某承认有关联
据法国当局称，寇某在警察局受审时承认，他是本地一个恐怖协会的执行人员，其工作是向该团伙成员分发弹药。
据说，寇某在供述时相当坦率，而与他一同被捕的两名男子也公开承认了他们与恐怖组织的联系。
根据他们提供的信息，一名女子在弗里鲁普路的一家小旅馆内被捕。据称她也与该团伙有关联。调查仍在继续。

加强预防措施
昨日，公共租界警察在市中心地区采取了额外的防炸弹措施。
除了加强警察巡逻外，还动用了俄罗斯团（Russian Regiment）成员进行密集巡逻。这些巡逻队每队五人，在中央区（Central District）和老闸区（Louza District）的每个街区单列行进。
他们携带步枪，夹在臂下，随时准备行动。

pages.en:
99

‘Sin Wan Pao’
Is Scene Of
New Bombing

Chinese Primary School
In Carter Road Also
Object Of Attack

TWO EPISODES OCCUR
AT SAME TIME

Armed Robbers In City On
Duty Last Night; Raid
Made By Sinza

Acts of terrorism were con-
tinued in Shanghai last evening
as bombings occurred in the
Central and Sinza Districts. At
about 7 o'clock in the evening
an explosion was reported at
the premises of the "Sin Wan
Pao" in Hankow Road, and a
few minutes later a hand
grenade was thrown into the
Wei Jcu Primary School at 191
Carter Road.

Fortunately no one was injured
at the "Sin Wan Pao" affair, and a
broken window was the only damage
done. The missile thrown at the
newspaper office was later identified
as a small hand grenade of a type
which has been seen in Shanghai
all too frequently of late.

No explanation could be given as
to why terrorists had chosen the
newspaper as a scene of operations
for their activities, unless it was
as a protest to the fact that the "Sin
Wan Pao" has submitted to Japan-
ese censorship.

The throwing of the hand gren-
ade at the school in Carter Road
was equally mysterious, detectives of
the Sinza Police Station stating at
a late hour last evening that they
had no idea as to whom the missile
had been intended. A coolie, who
happened to be in the entrance hall
at the time of the explosion, was
slightly injured.

Armed Robberies

A number of armed robberies were
also reported yesterday. The first
of these occurred at about 1.45 p.m.
when two gangsters, one of whom
was armed, victimized the inmates
of a place at 3 Sui Tuh Lih, off
Roobinson Road, and stole $25 in
cash.

At 5.45 o'clock four robbers, three
of whom were armed, entered a
house in lane 145 off Kuling Road.
There were a number of Chinese
in the place at the time, all of
whom were speedily intimidated by
the visitors and herded into a small
room. The robbers then busied
themselves in a thorough search for
loot and succeeded in getting away
with $1,155 in money and jewellery..

The next robbery occurred at 8.45
o'clock when five men, two of whom
were armed, entered a house
in lane 351 off Fokien Road and
made of with $400 in money and
jewellery. In another robbery a few
minutes later four men, one carry-
ing a pistol, entered a Chinese house
in Dah Hsu Lih off Robison Road
and took $616 in money and jewel-
lery.

Five Raids Made

Eight arrests were made and four
guns seized in a series of five raids
carried out by detectives from Sinza
station yesterday morning. Two of
the arrests were made with the co-
operation of the French Police,
while one of the detained persons
is a woman.

Starting out just before 8 a.m.
in response to a report, the detec-
tives first raided a house at 80 Sin
Kong-Lih, where they made one
arrest and seized two guns.

Information given by the arrest-
ed man led to a visit to two houses,
Nos. 54 and 52, Yao Zung Lih, off
Robison Road, four arrests being
made at the first house and one at
the second. Two guns were thrown
by a woman into a creek off
Robison Road as the squad ap-
proached but the weapons were
recovered.

Acting in co-operation with the
French police, the raiders roped in
two other members of the gang in
raids on houses in Rue Conty and
Rue de Marche.
pages.zh:
99

《新闻报》
成为新爆炸案
现场

卡特路的一所
中国小学也成
为袭击目标

两起事件同时
发生

昨夜执勤期间发生持械抢劫；
新闸捕房实施突袭

昨晚上海继续发生恐怖主义行为，中央区和新区（Sinza District，即新闸区）发生了爆炸案。晚上7点左右，据报道汉口路《新闻报》社发生爆炸，几分钟后，一枚手榴弹被投入卡特路191号的维杰小学（Wei Jcu Primary School，音译）。

幸运的是，《新闻报》事件中无人受伤，唯一的损失是一扇破碎的窗户。投向报社的投掷物后来被确认为一种小型手榴弹，这种类型的手榴弹最近在上海过于频繁地出现。

对于恐怖分子为何选择该报社作为其活动的场所，无法给出解释，除非这是为了抗议《新闻报》屈服于日本审查制度这一事实。

向卡特路学校投掷手榴弹的事件同样神秘，新闸捕房的侦探在昨晚深夜表示，他们不知道这枚投掷物的目标是谁。一名当时恰好在门厅的苦力受了轻伤。

持械抢劫

昨日还报告了多起持械抢劫案。第一起发生在下午1点45分左右，两名歹徒，其中一人持有武器，侵害了罗宾逊路（Roobinson Road，原文拼写有误，应为Robinson Road）附近绥德里3号的一处住所内的住户，抢走了25元现金。

5点45分，四名劫匪，其中三人持有武器，进入古岭路（Kuling Road，音译）145弄的一处房屋。当时屋内有数名中国人，所有人很快被闯入者恐吓，并被赶进一个小房间。随后劫匪忙于彻底搜寻财物，成功抢走价值1,155元的现金和珠宝后逃离。

下一宗抢劫案发生在8点45分，当时五名男子，其中两人持有武器，进入福建路351弄的一处房屋，抢走了价值400元的现金和珠宝。几分钟后发生的另一起抢劫案中，四名男子，其中一人携带手枪，进入罗宾逊路（Robison Road）附近大徐里（Dah Hsu Lih，音译）的一处中国住宅，抢走了价值616元的现金和珠宝。

五次突袭

新闸捕房侦探昨日上午进行了一系列五次突袭，共逮捕八人，缴获四支枪。其中两次逮捕是在法国警察的配合下进行的，被拘留者中有一名女性。

早上8点前，侦探们根据一份报告出发，首先突袭了新康里80号的一处房屋，在那里逮捕了一人并缴获两支枪。

根据被捕男子提供的信息，警方走访了罗宾逊路附近的姚忠里54号和52号两处房屋，在第一处房屋逮捕了四人，在第二处房屋逮捕了一人。当小队接近时，一名女子将两支枪扔进了罗宾逊路附近的一条小河沟里，但武器后被找回。

在与法国警察的合作下，突袭人员在孔蒂路（Rue Conty）和马歇路（Rue de Marche）的房屋突袭行动中，又抓获了两名该团伙成员。
